in_marathi.name: Mihir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mihir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mihir is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mihira' which means 'sun'. In Hindu mythology, Mihir is a name of the sun god Surya. It is also believed that Mihir is the name of a sage who is believed to have written the Vedas. The name Mihir is auspicious and symbolizes strength, power, and wisdom.
